Wayanad landslide: Deaths confirmed, search ongoing amid tunnel project probe

A deadly landslide in Wayanad, Kerala, has resulted in multiple confirmed deaths and several missing persons, with rescue operations continuing. The incident has prompted an investigation into the nearby twin tunnel project, with authorities halting work pending the probe. Builders have denied responsibility, stating the landslide occurred in a forest area.
